description: Anchorr: Stored XSS in User Mapping dropdown allows unprivileged Discord users to exfiltrate all secrets via /api/config
how_introduced: Yes. The AI-authored Claude Code commit 403ccf079be0ee5e6660f0ed2fa64174d76eff2f directly introduced the user-mapping dropdown and rendered Discord-controlled member data with unsafe `innerHTML`, creating the stored XSS sink. A later AI commit (8690a9f89e69f250d14614a4876f63c465177fce) touched related code, but the confirmed AI contribution is 403’s introduction of the vulnerable DOM construction path.

This commit is explicitly AI-authored (Claude Code), so AI directly introduced the stored XSS surface.
